notes: Sources cross-checked: Sound on Sound review (detailed rear/front panel walkthrough), Sweetwater and B&H spec listings, and manufacturer site content surfaced via search (prismsound.io/products/titan and tech-specs page returned HTTP 403 to direct fetch, so manufacturer figures were corroborated via search snippets and the SoS review rather than a direct page render). Key points: 4 combo XLR/TRS inputs (ch1-4) support mic or line level with software-controlled gain and individually switchable phantom power; front-panel TS instrument jacks on ch1-2 auto-sense and override to instrument level (ch1-2 also support RIAA EQ for turntable input); ch5-8 are TRS line-only inputs. All 8 outputs are TRS line level. Digital I/O: RCA pair doing S/PDIF or AES3 (AES3 via included XLR-to-RCA adapter cable, not a native XLR jack, so modeled as RCA), plus TOSLINK pair switchable between S/PDIF and 8-channel ADAT. Two BNC wordclock (in/out), no grade applicable. USB is USB2 Type-B (device/host-facing, bidirectional). A 10Mbps Ethernet RJ45 port is present but currently inert, reserved for a future AVB firmware feature - 10Mbps has no corresponding entry in the eth-* grade scale (which starts at eth-100m), so grade was omitted rather than misapplied. The MDIO expansion slot is a Prism-proprietary card slot (not a standard external connector) for optional modules (e.g., 8-channel AES3 card, Pro Tools HDX card); no exact ID exists in the allowed connector list; "euroblock" used only as an inert placeholder and this should be treated with low confidence / likely omitted or replaced by the app maintainer. No MIDI ports (removed vs. predecessor Orpheus; MIDI exists on the larger Atlas model, not Titan). Power figures (90-250VAC, 35W, 6A fuse) and rack dimensions (1U, 483x290x44.5mm rack-mount) are consistent across B&H, Sweetwater, and manufacturer-derived snippets.
